lines.text: Jehoram son of Ahab becomes king of Israel, removes Baal's sacred pillar, but clings to the sins of Jeroboam.
After Ahab dies, Mesha king of Moab rebels, so Jehoram asks Jehoshaphat of Judah to fight Moab, and he agrees.
The three kings take the Desert of Zin, run out of water after seven days, and go down to Elisha.
Elisha says to dig ditches in the valley, and the next morning water flows from the direction of Edom.
Moab sees the water as red as blood and attacks, but Israel wins; after the king of Moab burns his firstborn son, Israel captures Kir-haraseth.

wrong_details.true: Israel withdraws and returns to their own land
